content:
Rashmi Gupta: Running into a weird one on Android devclient with RN 0.72 + Expo devclient: sample app using the JS SDK fails only on Android (iOS ok). Request body becomes empty on retry and auth middleware rejects -> 401 loop.

Evan Park: Any console logs or stack? Is this the ESM build or CJS?

Rashmi Gupta: Using `@redwood/inference@0.9.2` default import. Metro warns about `node:buffer` but still bundles. Logs: `fetch /v1/chat -> 401`, then `TypeError: cannot read property 'slice' of undefined` from retry helper.

Noah Rivera: Slice error usually from trying to re-create a Uint8Array from an undefined body. Android's fetch (okhttp) doesn't support cloning bodies either. Did you enable Flipper? Flipper's network plugin can mutate requests sometimes.

Rashmi Gupta: Flipper is enabled. Disabling Flipper made the repro go away locally. CI (without Flipper) still fails for emulator test matrix on Android API 30. Suspect Hermes + expo-dev-client + RN fetch behavior mismatch.

Evan Park: Two paths: (A) quick app-side workaround: wrap global.fetch to buffer init.body into a Blob/ArrayBuffer before any retries (similar to earlier RN patches), (B) SDK fix: detect `isReactNative()` and copy body into a byte array before calling retry. I'll file a tiny SDK patch.

Noah Rivera: For sample app docs add a note: "If you see empty request bodies after a retry on Android: disable Flipper or apply fetch buffer wrapper." Also include Metro extraNodeModules for `react-native-get-random-values` for consistent crypto across platforms.

Rashmi Gupta: Minimal wrapper I used: `global.fetch = (i, init={}) => { if (init.body && typeof init.body.getReader !== 'function') return originalFetch(i, init); const buf = await readStreamToBuffer(init.body); init.body = buf; return originalFetch(i, init); }` — readStreamToBuffer implemented using RN Blob polyfill. Works for our e2e.

Evan Park: I'll open a hotfix branch and a changelog note. If Flipper mutates requests we should also add a CI job that runs emulators with Flipper on to catch this earlier.

docs-bot: Documentation request created: DOCS-412 "Expo sample: Android Flipper note + fetch-buffer workaround".

Rashmi Gupta: Leaving logs and a small repro in the ticket. Thanks.

(End of thread)
